style.toneOfVoice: A thoughtful take on festive decorating, this bauble garland features 12 mini baubles in elegant, bestselling shapes, each finished in a heritage-inspired matte tone. Strung on sari ties, the garland brings colour, texture, along with a subtle sense of movement to your space. This delicate scale makes it ideal for draping across mantels, winding through wreaths, or styling along a table setting to add warmth and charm with a handmade feel. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade feel.
